contracts.note: Contracts are not deployed yet. Official addresses are announced on the website at launch; any address published elsewhere before launch is not official.

description: QQAI ($QQAI) is a fair-launch token on BNB Smart Chain, sold on the project's own bonding curve. Buy with BNB or USDT (USDT converted at the real-time BNB/USD rate); the price rises as the curve fills. When the curve sells out, liquidity migrates automatically to two PancakeSwap pools (QQAI/WBNB and QQAI/USDT) and the LP is burned 100%. Buying on the curve is gated by Binance Agent ID. There is no presale and no private round.

graduation.liquidityReserveNote: The liquidity reserve is shared between the two graduation pools.
graduation.trigger: All 59.94 T $QQAI on the bonding curve sold.

name: QQAI

sale.gate: Buying on the curve requires a Binance Agent ID (checked against the Agent ID registry).
sale.sellBack: Before graduation, holders can sell $QQAI back into the curve at the current curve price at any time.
sale.usdtConversion: USDT payments are converted at the real-time BNB/USD rate at the moment of purchase, so USDT and BNB buyers receive the same curve price.

tokenomics.note: Paired at graduation across the QQAI/WBNB and QQAI/USDT PancakeSwap pools.

tokenomics.vesting: 365-day cliff, then linear vesting over 4 years
